title: Lume for Claude Chat: optional acceptance items (no gate)

items.question: Optional, non-blocking: how should the live Chat upload and 3-workflow test be run? The plugin, the tests and the PR proceed whatever the answer; with no answer the item stays NOT RUN.
options: A · A user runs CHAT-TEST-STEPS.md in their own Chat with synthetic content and posts the result on PR #62.
B · A user explicitly authorizes a separate signed-in session (account access).
C · Leave it NOT RUN; Chat compatibility stays unverified.
items.recommended: A · A user runs CHAT-TEST-STEPS.md in their own Chat with synthetic content and posts the result on PR #62.

items.question: Licensing approval, non-blocking: confirm the LICENSE holder text. The current text stays and no work waits; the agent changes it only on an explicit answer.
options: A · Keep the current holder text as it stands.
B · Replace it with exact holder text given by Pedro or Themis.
items.recommended: A · Keep the current holder text as it stands.
